responsibility: This definition module declares the gm2 generic character I/O dispatch layer. It defines procedure types for character readers and writers and exports Read and Write together with push/pop and query operations for the current input and output procedures, allowing higher-level libraries to redirect default character streams without depending directly on IO or FIO.
same_name_distinction: Interface half of the StdIO pair: it declares the ProcRead/ProcWrite procedure types and the redirection-stack API for generic character I/O, whereas the sibling module provides the actual stack storage and default bindings.
